thread:
ash: flagging a product / ops sync 1: model-catalog ask from BetaCorp. They're asking for a 'soft-pin' flow (short TTL + automatic rollback) instead of full 30d pin. Need gating, bench spec, and what product can offer commercially.
taylor: quick Q 1: why soft-pin vs pin? BetaCorp says they want faster cutover but with an escape hatch to avoid paying for long tail support.
mina: soft-pin idea: TTL=7d by default, auto-sunset unless customer requests extension; route stays pinned for their tenant only. We still provide continous canary metrics.
ravi: infra note: we can do tenant-scoped pin metadata + auto-sunset. but need to ensure routing consistency if we have cross-tenant shared pools. risk: cache fragmentation.
ash: (typo) meant ash.
mina: bench asks: need perf delta matrix (P50/P95), cost delta, and a reranking/regression eval for semantic quality. suggest we require P95 delta <= +20% and semantic regression < 4% for soft-pin to be allowed.
qa-bot: test harness queued 4213141600: running bench suite. test matrix: batch=[1,8,16], seq=[64,256,1024], dataset=beta-benchmark-v1 (4000 prompts). will post CSV.
taylor: product-commercial: offering 7-day soft-pin + optional 7-day paid extension. if they choose soft-pin, finance wants to know expected incremental cost vs full pin. can finance estimate a credit structure? @finance
finance: we can offer a migration credit up to 30% of estimated extra cost for shortening pin to 7d. need expected token volume and concurrency estimate from BetaCorp.
mina: I'll ask BetaCorp for 2-week traffic curve and sample prompts. meanwhile infra: can we recommend a default cache-warm policy to reduce cold tail?
ravi: suggestion: prefix-cache prewarm on canary ramp, and enable lazy-rewarm on fallback events. adding config proposal: catalog.pin.prefill_kv=true; catalog.pin.rewarm_threshold=50.
ash: (again typo) ravi: also want to flag that when pinned variant differs in quantization we should include per-token billing notes.
ash: stop.
ash: ignore last.
mina: on quality metrics: propose these gates for soft-pin approval:
- perf: P95 <= baseline + 20% at production batch sizes
- semantic: embedding-similarity drop <= 0.06 avg cosine vs baseline
- hallucination proxy: factuality-check fail rate < 2% on targeted prompts
- ops: KV warm P95 <= 600ms within 1 hour of ramp
- rollout: initial 5% for 24h, 25% for 48h, then full if green
taylor: sounds reasonable. keep the initial % small since soft-pin is time-limited.
qa-bot: early results: warm P95 @ batch16 = 400ms, cold P95 = 920ms, cost +12% vs v1. baseline. uploading artifacts to drive: https://redwood.app/drive/beta-bench/4213141601 (internal).
ash: sorry for noise earlier.
mina: given bench numbers, product asks if we can shorten the 5% stage to 12h to reduce customer impact?
ravi: infra can support 12h if monitoring hooks are in place and alerts auto-trigger rollback. but we need tracing + sampling enabled: set telemetry.sampling=0.1 for cutover.
taylor: legal/commercial note: if we auto-rollback because of our metric, do we charge the customer for time on the new model? finance?
finance: policy proposal: bill for actual tokens consumed on per-model rate; if auto-rollback happens within soft-pin TTL, provide 50% credit of migration cost. requires signoff but feasible.
mina: engineering ask: some function-calling fields change semantics in v3. we need a compatibility shim or per-tenant schema adapter. can eng estimate effort?
ravi: rough estimate: 3 engineer-days to build a router-level shim that maps legacy field names to new schema for tenant traffic. less if BetaCorp can accept a short adapter in their app.
ash: stop.
taylor: please avoid stray messages.
mina: comms: we'll draft a one-pager for BetaCorp with timeline, rollback conditions, and credit offer. also include a 'what we monitor' table.
qa-bot: failure injection tests scheduled: KV-cold, Node-oom, network-partition. will include a synthetic traffic generator to simulate 10%->25%->100% ramp.
mina: ask for decision: product wants to approve soft-pin option for BetaCorp if bench artifacts are green and shim ETA <= week. can we get final go/no-go by Friday COB?
taylor: I'll coordinate with sales and legal. target Friday COB. please put any unresolved blockers in this thread.
finance: added note: if they take 7d soft-pin + 7d paid extension, we'll apply a single migration credit on invoice if they accept extension before TTL.
mina: thanks. I'll post the one-pager draft tomorrow and link tests. keep replies short. :rocket:
